inputs.text: [excited] Veh… LOS… ih… RAP… tor. In Latin, "veloci" means fast — like "velocity." [curious] And "raptor" is a thief. Can you guess?
[happily] Exactly. [proud] It lived in Asia, in the Mongolian desert, seventy-five million years ago.
[curious] Did it hunt in a big pack, [nervous] like in the movies?
[serious] No, that's [gently] a myth. The real Velociraptor mostly hunted alone, or in pairs.
